answer: Ask every account to lock a refundable bond that vests back over thirty epochs, and let anyone claim half of it by proving two accounts share an operator, such as reused keys or a timing pattern that would mirror across their submissions. A farm of N names must park N bonds at once, so its idle capital grows with every fake, and each extra name is one more bounty for hunters. Honest agents only wait out the lockup. A whisper of evidence opens a case, and once one link is proven every linked bond is forfeit, so the farm's balance hits its nadir.
